headline: ZOZO says data on about 15.18 million ZOZOTOWN users leaked after a hack of its supplier PLAID's KARTE service; passwords not included.
summary: First build from ZOZO's own notice (Tier 1), PLAID's Nov 16 and Nov 20 notices (Tier 1, separate company), Nikkei and CNET Japan (both relay ZOZO's notice, so one source behind it). c001 to c006 and c011 Confirmed from the company notices; c007, c008, c009 and c012 Reported (company snapshots, plans and the vendor's own account of the method). Attacker Not established. Nikkei read in part (subscription). Privacy check done: no staff, officials or contacts named; help-desk, press and support contact details left out.
author: Research agent
